name: Chicken Waldorf Salad with Romaine Lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Place chicken in a small saucepan. Season with salt and pepper. Cover with water and bring to a boil. Reduce heat, cover, and simmer until chicken is cooked through, 8-12 minutes. Remove from liquid and place on a plate.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 lb chicken breasts, boneless skinless
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: In a large bowl, prepare dressing by whisking together mayo, lemon juice, honey, mustard, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup mayonnaise
1 lemon
1 tsp honey
½ tsp Dijon mustard
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add walnuts and, stirring constantly, toast until golden brown, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat to cool.

Wash apples, celery, grapes, and chives. Core, medium dice, and add apples to bowl with dressing. Trim ends, medium dice, and add celery to bowl. Halve grapes and add to bowl. Chop chives and add to bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 Gala apples
4 sticks celery
½ lb red grapes
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry lettuce. Halve lengthwise, then chop crosswise into 1 inch strips.
Pat dry the chicken with paper towels, medium dice, and add to bowl. Toss salad until well combined.
To serve, arrange a bed of lettuce leaves on a plate and top with salad. Enjoy!
